name: Draconic Wild Shape
body:
You can change into a draconic animal.

Prerequisite(s): Wild shape class feature, Knowledge (arcana) 5 ranks.

Benefit(s): When you use wild shape to take the form of an animal, you can expend an additional daily use of your wild shape class feature to add the draconic LC creature template to your animal form. You can select a different draconic variety every time you use this ability.
